extension.description: Browse and query Elasticsearch clusters, with the same approval rules as every other asset
assetType.elasticsearch.name: Elasticsearch
config.endpoint.title: Address
config.endpoint.desc: Cluster URL. A path prefix is kept, for clusters behind a reverse proxy such as https://gateway.example/es.
config.authType.title: Authentication
config.authType.desc: None, username and password, an API key, or a bearer token
config.username.title: Username
config.password.title: Password
config.apiKey.title: API key
config.apiKey.desc: The encoded value Elasticsearch returns when the key is created
config.token.title: Bearer token
policy.readOnly.name: Read only
policy.readOnly.description: Check health, list indices, read mappings and search without asking
policy.readWrite.name: Read and write
policy.readWrite.description: Also index, update and bulk-load documents without asking. Deletes and management still ask
tools.request.description: Send any REST request to the cluster and return its status and body
tools.health.description: Cluster name, version, status, node count and shard counts
tools.indices.description: List indices with health, status, document count and size
tools.search.description: Search an index with Query DSL or a query string and return the hits
page.cluster.title: Cluster
page.error.auth.title: Authentication failed
page.error.auth.hint: Elasticsearch refused the credentials. Check the asset's authentication type and its username and password, API key or token.
page.error.unreachable.title: Can't reach the cluster
page.error.unreachable.hint: No answer from the asset's address. Check the address, the SSH tunnel or proxy, and TLS settings.
page.error.other.title: Couldn't load the cluster
page.indices.title: Indices
page.indices.systemHint: Show system and hidden indices (names starting with .)
page.indices.onlySystem: Only system indices here. Turn on System to see them.
page.overview.notGreenNoIndex: No index reports a problem yet; shards may still be starting or relocating.
page.overview.yellowReason: Replica shards are unassigned. Common on a single node, or when an index has more replicas than there are nodes to hold them.
page.overview.redReason: Primary shards are unassigned, so some of this index's data can't be searched.
page.overview.node.name: Name
page.overview.node.rolesHint: One letter per role, e.g. m = master-eligible, d = data, i = ingest
page.docs.queryStringPlaceholder: Lucene query, e.g. level:error AND service:api. Leave empty for all documents
page.docs.dslInvalid: The DSL isn't a JSON object
page.docs.emptyIndex: This index has no documents yet
page.docs.windowReason: Elasticsearch serves a page only while from + size stays within the index's max_result_window ({{window}}). Narrow the query or sort differently to reach later hits.
page.console.runHint: Run the request under the cursor (⌘/Ctrl+Enter)
page.console.editorPlaceholder: GET /_search — ⌘/Ctrl+Enter runs the request under the cursor
page.console.idle: Put the cursor on a request and press ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to see its response here.
